companies.name: TMC Transformers
companies.quote: Our main facility in Busto Arsizio, in northern Italy, specializes in the design and production of dry transformers for unique and demanding applications, with capacities up to 25MVA and 52kV. Nearby, in Marnate, our second site focuses on manufacturing standard distribution transformers. In southern italy, in Fabro (Umbria), our third facility is entirely dedicated to producing low-voltage dry transformers and reactors, primarily designed with direct and indirect water-cooling systems. As part of our fully integrated production chain, TMC Transformers benefits from its in-house metalwork company, Officine Tironi, based in Bergamo. Specializing in the manufacturing of protective metal enclosures up to IP67, we ensure that every transformer is equipped with a robust, precisely engineered housing that guarantees optimal protection and durability, even in the most challenging outdoor environments. Over the years, TMC has expanded its global presence, establishing commercial offices in Germany, Spain, Switzerland, and the APAC region to better serve international markets with efficiency and expertise. To further strengthen our production capabilities, we have also opened two advanced manufacturing plants in the United States (Waynesboro, GA) and Israel, meeting the growing global demand for high-quality transformers. In addition, we have founded a joint venture in Thailand, reinforcing our commitment to the APAC market and enabling localized production and support for regional customers.
